name: office-connector
description: Let Hermes work in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and classic Outlook. Drives the documents you have open, and writes a new report or letter in a window it opens for you rather than as a file in the background, so you watch it take shape. Word changes to your own documents arrive as tracked revisions you can accept or reject, and with OFFICE_LIVE_MARK_AI=on every text it adds is underlined for your review until you take the underline off. In Outlook it searches mail, calendar and contacts and composes messages and meetings, then opens them for you — it never sends or saves; you press Send. Windows for now.
